_doc: Privileged-slot classification for every contract DeployAll constructs (and their bases). Each slot is either read by the post-deploy deployer/factory sweep (AdminChecks: checked, or checked:<getter>) or exempt with the reason it is not a privilege. scripts/ci/privileged_slots_tripwire.sh keeps this file, the contract sources and the sweep's probe list in step.

slots.ComputeMarketplace.allProviders: exempt: providers self-register by staking; the list grants no authority
slots.ComputeMarketplace.autoAssignOptIn: exempt: a provider's own opt-in flag, set by each provider for itself; it grants no power over anyone else
slots.ContributionAccounting.contributorList: exempt: the same bookkeeping as isContributor, as a list
slots.ContributionAccounting.isContributor: exempt: bookkeeping of who has contribution history, written by recorders; membership grants nothing
slots.HeartbeatMonitor.registered: exempt: provider self-registration for heartbeat tracking; grants no authority
slots.InferenceRouter.allProviders: exempt: providers self-register (msg.sender); the list grants no authority
slots.NematocystSlashing.banned: exempt: a penalty list; being in it removes rights rather than granting any
slots.StablecoinTreasury.acceptedStablecoins: exempt: keyed by stablecoin token contracts, not by actors
slots.StablecoinTreasury.stablecoinList: exempt: the accepted stablecoin token contracts, not actors
slots.TestnetFarmingAccounting.hasClaimed: exempt: per-participant claim bookkeeping; grants nothing
slots.TestnetFarmingAccounting.isSnapshotted: exempt: per-participant snapshot bookkeeping; grants nothing
slots.TestnetFarmingAccounting.snapshotPartici: exempt: the snapshotted participants, as a list; grants nothing
